method: Existing native mesh-animation workflow adapted to one continuous high-resolution full-body texture. All visible anatomy, including eyes, organs and feet, remains on one continuous surface; no separated body parts. Bilinear alpha-aware texture sampling with 2x antialiasing.
timingReference: Existing spring flow-v4: 16 x 70ms, grounded fluid locomotion, no airborne frames.
motionNote: Gentle grounded flow: lower body widens and recovers; tip follows with a delayed response. Approved V1 motion, not an exact copy of the previous runtime motion.
